Data.title: Employed Residents Aged 15 Years and Over by Planning Area of Workplace, Highest Qualification Attained and Sex
Data.footnote: Notes: Planning areas refer to areas demarcated in the Urban Redevelopment Authority's Master Plan 2019. Data refers to the usual workplace location and not the temporary arrangements due to COVID-19 measures. Data pertain to residents who were not attending educational institutions as full-time students and include those who were upgrading their qualifications through part-time courses.
